reason: Cash on delivery for the first order, a fixed written quote, and Abu Ali's name on the receipt means I risk almost nothing, so I would send one small test order of a few pieces to see if the landed cost and the 3-week date are real before I trust them with stock for my shop.
objection: 13,000 IQD a kilo by air eats my margin on cheap pieces I resell, and they don't say what the slow cargo or the trader per-kilo rate actually is. After the first order I have to put down 30% and wait weeks, so if they're late my shelf is empty.
